name: VowEdit — Re-edit beside your AI
description: Human-operated local image boundaries. Offline Mock, no analytics or automatic page collection.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: script-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; frame-src 'none'; connect-src 'self' http://127.0.0.1:*; img-src 'self' blob:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; font-src 'self'; base-uri 'none'
